_about: UK kitchen examples for the demo (plan onb-08, schema contracts/kitchen-example.ts). Set price ≠ fitted price: see priceIncludes/priceExcludes. Colours measured on shop photos (.memory_bank/_intake/kitchens-2026-11/uk-1325/). Shop photos are link-only — the demo shows our 3D frame and a link to the shop.

Not included: «sink, water trap, tap, knobs or handles, appliances and lighting». Plan draft had £845 — page shows £917 on 05.11.

examples.nameEn: Wickes Milton Sage shaker kitchen, 8 units
examples.priceNote: «From £2,280» — 8-unit kitchen (~10 m²), units only: 1000 base, 1000 wall, built-under oven unit, drawer unit, 500 base, 2×300 wall, larder/appliance tower, appliance doors 600×731 and 600×1319. Excluded on the page: appliances, worktops, sinks, taps, plinths, end panels, accessories; handles not in the photo price; delivery £97.50.
